summary: Frontend-only verification of the CRMEvent subscription-model Events page (no credits/activation for saas.enabled orgs). Executed on https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com. VERIFIED OK: (1) New org registration via /registrati with +393331234567 — redirects to /app and header shows data-testid='trial-days-button' with text '14 giorni rimasti' (aria-label 'Prova gratuita: 14 giorni rimasti') immediately with zero events. (2) Welcome popup can be closed via [data-testid='welcome-demo-skip'] ('Lo farò in seguito' label). (3) /eventi for the newly-registered saas org (empty list) shows table headers ['Evento','Tipologia','Città','Date','Fase','Azioni'] — the 'CRMEvent' column is correctly omitted. No event-credit-badge-* elements present. (4) Clicking data-testid='add-event-button' opens the 'Nuovo evento' dialog DIRECTLY — no [data-testid='event-no-credits-dialog'], no 'Attiva evento' ActivationGate popup, no credit prompt. First event (TEST_EvUI_Ev1) was persisted successfully (dialog closed). (5) Legacy QA org (qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it): /eventi correctly shows the 'CRMEvent' column header, 10x event-credit-badge-* elements, and 'Altre' secondary dropdown action (unchanged). CRITICAL BLOCKER FOUND: for saas orgs with ANY event on the list, /eventi crashes with a React Runtime Error ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "run")'). Reproduced on both the pre-seeded test_events1@crmeventqa.it (3 events) AND on my newly-registered org right after the first event was created. Root cause pinpointed in /app/frontend/src/pages/Events.jsx line 313: `const secondary = ["event-credits","briefing"].map(byKey);` — when `saas=true`, the 'event-credits' entry is omitted from `all` (line 304), so `byKey("event-credits")` returns `undefined`; the subsequent `secondary.map(a => ... a.run ...)` on line 333-334 explodes. Impact: the entire Events page is unusable for every subscription-model org that has at least one event — the whole feature under test is broken. Because the page crashes immediately, I could NOT further verify: counter unchanged after 2 creations, logout/re-login counter, expired-trial read-only+'Scopri i piani' flow, mobile 375px rendering with events, and backend 400 on /api/events/{id}/activate (frontend-only scope anyway). The empty-list path, add-event dialog path and legacy flows DO work.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading run)' for every row when user.saas.enabled=true. Caused by `secondary = ["event-credits","briefing"].map(byKey)` returning undefined for 'event-credits' (which is intentionally excluded from `all` under saas). Then `secondary.map(a => <DropdownMenuItem onClick={a.run} data-testid={`menu-${a.key}-${row.id}`}>…<a.Icon/>{a.label}</DropdownMenuItem>)` throws on undefined. The mobile branch (`all.map`) is fine because it iterates the already-filtered list.

action_items: FIX /app/frontend/src/pages/Events.jsx line 313: replace `const secondary = ["event-credits","briefing"].map(byKey);` with `const secondary = (saas ? ["briefing"] : ["event-credits","briefing"]).map(byKey);` (or `.map(byKey).filter(Boolean)`). Without this, EVERY saas org with ≥1 event sees a Runtime Error on /eventi — the subscription Events page is completely non-functional.

After the fix, re-run the full checklist: counter stability after N creations, logout/relogin counter, expired-trial (set organizations.saas.trial_end to past via mongosh) read-only + 'Scopri i piani' CTA via trial-days-button popup, mobile 375px render, backend POST /api/events/{id}/activate 400 for saas orgs.

critical_code_review_comments: Events.jsx has an unsafe lookup pattern: `byKey = (k) => all.find(a=>a.key===k)` can return undefined; always chain `.filter(Boolean)` after a `.map(byKey)` OR drive the secondary/primary lists from the already-filtered `all` array. The same pattern on line 312 (`primary = [...].map(byKey)`) is currently safe only because those four keys are unconditional, but it is equally fragile — refactor both.

The saas gating in Events.jsx (line 304, 394-399, 441, 451 and the add-event guardCreate bypass) is otherwise correct — the credit column, credit badges, 'Crediti' row action and no-credits dialog are properly omitted for saas and present for legacy. The regression is purely the dropdown undefined bug above.

rca of the issue: File: /app/frontend/src/pages/Events.jsx. Lines 302-313 build an `all` actions list with the 'event-credits' entry gated behind `!saas`, then build a `secondary = ["event-credits","briefing"].map(byKey)` without filtering. For user.saas.enabled=true, `byKey("event-credits")` returns undefined, so `secondary = [undefined, {briefing}]`. The desktop render path (lines 333-337) does `secondary.map(a => <DropdownMenuItem onClick={a.run} data-testid={`menu-${a.key}-${row.id}`}><a.Icon/>{a.label}</DropdownMenuItem>)` — accessing `.run/.key/.Icon/.label` on `undefined` throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "run")'. Mitigation (minimal change): either `const secondary = (saas ? ["briefing"] : ["event-credits","briefing"]).map(byKey);` or `const secondary = ["event-credits","briefing"].map(byKey).filter(Boolean);`. Reproduction steps: (1) login as any user with user.saas.enabled=true (e.g., test_events1@crmeventqa.it/TestSaas2026!), (2) navigate to /eventi — the whole page crashes to Emergent Runtime Error overlay as soon as any row renders.
